proposal.reason: Main change adds an independent TROCE built-in GIN backend end-to-end (device API specializations, host context lifecycle, MR registration, CQ/SQ progress, dynamic libtroce provider wiring, and GIN type/device-type integration). It also makes an independently substantive shared-network change by updating net_ib provider classification/detection logic (including TROCE provider identity in common/init paths), which affects network transport policy beyond incidental wiring.
